eyebrow: Simulating a batch your GPU can't fit

steps.label: Micro-batch
steps.sub: forward + backward on a small chunk

code:
accum_steps = 4
optimizer.zero_grad()

for i, (x, y) in enumerate(train_loader):
    loss = loss_fn(model(x), y) / accum_steps
    loss.backward()

    if (i + 1) % accum_steps == 0:
        optimizer.step()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
caption: 4 micro-batches of 16 behave like one batch of 64.

code:
# WRONG -- gradient ends up 4x too large
loss = loss_fn(model(x), y)
loss.backward()

# RIGHT -- matches a real large-batch average
loss = loss_fn(model(x), y) / accum_steps
loss.backward()
caption: Skipping the divide silently multiplies your learning rate.
